notes: Modified cash basis school district. Receipts/disbursements from the Total Governmental Funds column (pp4-5). Beginning/ending cash = total governmental fund balances (9,981,517 / 10,941,467, p5), which comprise cash, investments (ending 1,350,975, p6) and cash at county treasurer; investments shown for information. Printed statement total net change 959,950 and roll-forward tie as printed, but the printed lines are off by rounding (see report_discrepancies). Statement 'Other' 12,705 split using fund schedules (carline tax 2,988+551+647, license fees 6,522, police court fines 1,400, other 597 per GF components p7 and Bond/Special Building p17-18). Statement 'Interest' 211,040 split into investment income and penalty/interest on delinquent taxes (24,587 = 17,925 + 3,397 + 3,265) from fund schedules; rounding of a few dollars possible. Transfers: statement total column shows no net transfers (GF -100,000 to Nutrition, Other Governmental +100,000); the 140,000 General Fund to Depreciation transfer sits inside the General Fund column, which combines General and Depreciation funds (p7-9), and is printed within Regular instruction (70,000) and Student transportation (70,000) lines as a reclassification (p9). Left transfers_in/out null. Detail: General Fund budget-and-actual schedule (pp10-14) used as the more detailed General Fund source over the combining schedule (pp7-9); disbursement lines carry the hidden 140,000 so contra lines (-70,000 each) and an other-financing transfer (-140,000) were added, with the printed 8000 transfer -100,000; detail total 13,033,994 includes the transfers. Budget schedule lines with blank 2025 actual not recorded (1291/1292 etc. where blank, 4510, 5690, Transfers CB 235 budget 2,000,000). Depreciation Fund capital outlay has blank actual. Activities Fund per-account schedule not in trimmed PDF; one-line schedule recorded.
